description: This file defines a selector generator for DOM elements, used in Playwright's injected scripts. It includes functions to generate CSS and XPath-like selectors with scoring, caching, and heuristics for element identification.

methods.name: generateSelector
methods.description: Main function to generate a selector for a target element with options, returning the best selector, all selectors, and matching elements.

methods.name: generateSelectorFor
methods.description: Generates a specific selector token array for an element, considering text and no-text heuristics, with recursive parent handling.

methods.name: buildNoTextCandidates
methods.description: Builds candidate selectors based on attributes, labels, ARIA roles, and other heuristics, excluding text content.

methods.name: buildTextCandidates
methods.description: Builds candidate selectors based on text content, including titles, alt text, labels, ARIA labels, and regex matches.

methods.name: makeSelectorForId
methods.description: Creates a CSS selector for an element ID, using a simple ID selector if possible.

methods.name: hasCSSIdToken
methods.description: Checks if a token array contains a CSS ID selector.

methods.name: cssFallback
methods.description: Generates a fallback CSS selector path for an element based on ID, class, and position.

methods.name: penalizeScoreForLength
methods.description: Adjusts scores of tokens based on their length to prefer shorter, more precise selectors.

methods.name: joinTokens
methods.description: Joins an array of selector tokens into a string selector with appropriate combinators.

methods.name: combineScores
methods.description: Calculates a combined score for a set of selector tokens, lower scores are better.

methods.name: isGuidLike
methods.description: Determines if an ID string resembles a GUID based on character transitions.

methods.name: trimWordBoundary
methods.description: Trims a string to a maximum length at a word boundary.

methods.name: suitableTextAlternatives
methods.description: Generates alternative text snippets with score bonuses for more robust matching.

methods.name: escapeNodeName
methods.description: Escapes node names for use in query selectors.

methods.name: escapeClassName
methods.description: Escapes class names for use in query selectors.

methods.name: cssEscapeCharacter
methods.description: Escapes individual characters for CSS identifiers.
